shorts.title: Microbes Buried 100 Million Years Woke Up for Lunch
shorts.hook: These seafloor microbes were buried for a hundred million years.
shorts.outro: The six shorter traps are in the full video below.
shorts.description: Seafloor microbes buried since the dinosaurs ate and divided the moment scientists fed them; the six shorter traps are in the full Doomed Doug episode.

shorts.title: The Ice Kept Ötzi 5,000 Years, People Damaged Him in 4 Days
shorts.outro: Doug lies down in that same hollow in the full video below.
shorts.description: A glacier hollow in the Alps preserved the Iceman for five millennia, then his recovery did damage in days; Doug lies down in that same hollow in the full episode.

shorts.title: Worms Frozen Since the Neanderthals Are Still Breeding
shorts.hook: Worms frozen for forty-six thousand years woke up in a lab.
shorts.outro: Doug's other six deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: Roundworms thawed from 46,000-year-old Siberian permafrost have kept reproducing in a lab for over a hundred generations; Doug's other six deaths are in the full episode.
